items.notes: UAC registry keys, timezone, PS execution policy, admin folder, API folder removal

items.description: Install Windows features: AD-Domain-Services, DNS, RSAT-AD-PowerShell, RSAT-ADDS, RSAT-DNS-Server, BitLocker, RSAT-Feature-Tools-BitLocker-BdeAducExt using ansible.windows.win_feature with include_sub_features: true
items.notes: Installs all AD DS, DNS, RSAT, BitLocker features as a list with sub-features

items.description: Promote first DC and build AD forest using microsoft.ad.domain; triggers reboot. Ensure NTDS service is Running/Automatic via ansible.windows.win_service
items.notes: Promotes first DC, builds forest, ensures NTDS and ADWS services are running

items.description: Configure domain default password and lockout policy: PasswordHistoryCount=24, MinPasswordLength=30, ComplexityEnabled, LockoutThreshold=50, etc. via microsoft.ad.domain_password_policy or win_shell
items.notes: Sets domain password and lockout policy via Set-ADDefaultDomainPasswordPolicy

items.description: Create AD replication sites: cool-name-SE1 (rename default), cool-name-LAS, cool-name-ORG using win_shell with New-ADReplicationSite / Rename-ADObject
items.notes: Creates/renames AD replication sites: cool-name-SE1 (renamed from default), cool-name-LAS, cool-name-ORG

items.description: Create KDS Root Key for gMSA support using win_shell: Add-KdsRootKey -EffectiveTime with AllowUnsafeEffectiveTime
items.notes: Creates KDS Root Key with backdated effective time using Add-KdsRootKey -Force

items.description: Create all AD security groups (Universal/Security): Admin-Tier-Zero, Admin-Tier-One, Admin-Tier-Two, PAW-Users, Admin-DHCP-Manage, Admin-Domain-Join, Admin-SQL-Group, Admin-gmsa-SQL-Group, Cluster-Tier-One, Cluster-Tier-Zero, Admin-gmsa-SCVMM-Group using microsoft.ad.group
items.notes: Creates all 11 AD security groups (Universal/Security scope) using microsoft.ad.group

items.description: Create Group Managed Service Accounts: gmsaSVC-SQL and gmsaSVC-SCVMM using win_shell with New-ADServiceAccount and -PrincipalsAllowedToRetrieveManagedPassword
items.notes: Creates gmsaSVC-SQL and gmsaSVC-SCVMM gMSA accounts using microsoft.ad.service_account

items.description: Create OU hierarchy: Resources, PM, DHCP (under PM), Critical Systems/Guarded Fabric/Applications/Managed Devices (under Resources) using microsoft.ad.ou in dependency order
items.notes: Creates full OU hierarchy in dependency order using microsoft.ad.ou

items.description: Pre-stage disabled Cluster Name Objects (CNOs): COREADMIN, CORESQL, CORESQLDR, COREPRIMARY, CORESECONDARY, CORESOFS using microsoft.ad.computer with enabled: false
items.notes: Pre-stages 6 CNOs (COREADMIN, CORESQL, CORESQLDR, COREPRIMARY, CORESECONDARY, CORESOFS) as disabled computer accounts

items.description: Configure DNS: conditional forwarders (Cool Name, cool-name.net), default forwarders (10.78.62.176, 10.78.130.26), AD-integrated reverse zone 10.in-addr.arpa using win_shell with DNS PowerShell cmdlets
items.notes: Configures DNS conditional forwarders, default forwarders, and AD-integrated reverse zone

items.description: Create AD user accounts: AD-Domain-Join, DC-Domain-Join (default Users container), AdminOne/AdminTwo/AdminThree (Managed Devices OU) using microsoft.ad.user with password_never_expires and cannot_change_password
items.notes: Creates AD-Domain-Join, DC-Domain-Join service accounts and AdminOne/Two/Three admin users

items.notes: Created by MoleculeAgent (deterministic scaffold)

items.description: Molecule converge playbook — creates expected filesystem state under /tmp/molecule_test/ (admin_path directory present, api_folder_path absent)
items.notes: Creates /tmp/molecule_test/ directory tree with marker files representing: admin folder, OS baseline (UAC/timezone/PS policy), AD replication sites, 11 AD security groups, 2 gMSAs, 7 OUs, 6 CNOs, DNS config, and 5 AD user accounts. No become, no Windows modules, all paths under /tmp/molecule_test/.

items.description: Molecule verify playbook — checks /tmp/molecule_test/ paths: UAC registry keys, NTDS service state, AD objects (domain, groups, OUs, CNOs, users, DNS zones)
items.notes: Split into 4 plays: (1) base OS/filesystem markers, (2) AD groups/gMSAs/OUs, (3) CNOs/DNS/users, (4) Windows-only AD DS/service checks tagged molecule-notest. Uses stat+assert+slurp pattern throughout. All loops use prefixed loop_vars and bracket notation.
